description: SOURCE EVIDENCE: With a trial or paid key, inspect a supported canonical GOV.UK Content API page; return documented title, update timestamps and a reproducible source fingerprint, and optionally check whether a quoted passage is present. Useful for assistants citing UK guidance. No legal or factual correctness guarantee; not every GOV.UK page is supported.

api_key.description: Optional UKSI API key (usi_...). Prefer supplying Authorization: Bearer KEY in MCP connection settings rather than exposing paid keys in tool calls.

previous_fingerprint.description: Optional previously observed SHA-256 fingerprint to compare.

quote.description: Optional exact quote to check for presence, maximum 400 characters.

url.description: Full canonical https://www.gov.uk/ URL for a supported Content API page.

name: inspect_govuk_page
